scientific_integrity: All polynomial identities and rational expanding matrices admit exact symbolic replay; the universal proof uses compactness, the resultant, Descartes sign variations, and endpoint signs. Novelty is best-knowledge, without independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic, fixed three-inner-call unprojected iteration; normal real 2x2 monotone saddle gradients only. The source method uses a conservative 1/(2L) step and increasing inner budget. No general nonlinear or nonnormal guarantee is asserted.
title: A sharp stability radius and damping-induced divergence in three-step approximate proximal descent
